entities.note: large colour-9 plus: vertical bar col 36 rows 32-58 and horizontal bar row 45 cols 23-49 (27x27, 53 px) whose CENTRE pixel (45,36) is BLACK(0) = this is the piece the arrows move; the black centre is the only marker of the active piece
colour-11 plus, 23x23: vertical bar col 21 rows 16-38, horizontal bar row 27 cols 10-32; idle (centre in its own colour) until ACTION5 makes it the active piece
3x3 colour-4 squares with a colour-9 centre pixel at (16,48), (24,40), (24,53), (35,48) (row,col): a plus-shaped constellation; each centre must be covered by a colour-9 bar
3x3 colour-4 squares with a colour-11 centre at (3,15), (9,6), (9,24), (17,15); each must be covered by a colour-11 bar
row 63: colour 15 from the left = remaining steps (64 px = 100), colour 1 eats in from the RIGHT (about 0.64 px per action); every action costs 1

rules.note: the ACTIVE piece (black centre) moves up 3 px; the other piece stays; costs 1 step

a move is refused only when the piece's CENTRE pixel would leave the 64x64 frame; the arms may hang off-screen; the step is still spent (same for ACTION2/3/4). Pieces never collide with each other or with the dots: overlaps are allowed
the other piece becomes active: its centre pixel turns black(0) and the previously active piece's centre returns to its own colour (cycles through the pieces in order); nothing moves; costs 1 step

goal.note: every dot centre of colour c must be covered by a bar of colour c at the same time: cross9 must cover all four colour-9 dots (column at col 48, row at row 24) AND cross11 must cover all four colour-11 dots (column col 15, row row 9); checked after every action; minimum 20 actions (11 moves + ACTION5 + 8 moves)
